visionReview.reviewScope: targeted parameter family in a fixed scene; not whole-scene approval
visionReview.reason: Placement changes cannot repair the angular shared plant geometry or create missing leaf-litter richness. All retain the inherited world boundary. No variant is approval quality; retain the baseline rather than interpreting more vegetation as success.

candidates.reason: Low plants reduce angular foreground clutter, but framing becomes weak and the large brown floor looks even barer.

assessment.composition: Center remains readable but poorly framed

candidates.reason: Stronger edge massing introduces oversized angular foreground fronds without making the central floor natural; lower-detail assets dominate the image.

assessment.composition: Foreground foliage competes with the opening
assessment.silhouette: Large clipped angular fronds are distracting
assessment.vegetation: More mass is not more botanical plausibility
assessment.lighting: Dark foreground geometry needs material/shape work
assessment.overallAppeal: Reject; density alone does not fix asset quality

candidates.reason: Best relative framing and patch variation of the three, but the bare floor, angular foliage and inherited inspection boundary prevent approval.

assessment.vegetation: More irregular sizes, still generic life-form geometry
assessment.groundRichness: Still too smooth and brown against the leaf-litter reference
assessment.repetition: No circle regression; repeated plant silhouettes remain
assessment.overallAppeal: Small relative improvement, not good enough

parameterDifferenceExplanation: Exact differences between the three controlled candidate profiles. The retained baseline uses its frozen source generator rather than this candidate parameterization.

lighting.mode: Fixed existing composition C; no simulated time-of-day change
